03. Research notes

3.1 Data notes

Collection. Traffic figures in this report, article, ranking, or chart come from deep integration of diversified hybrid sources, refined with Unique Research’s proprietary algorithms. The set combines market observation and technical insight, then is labeled, classified, and organized by the Unique Research team to reflect AI product market dynamics as fully and accurately as possible.

Scope. Data covers users on PCs, tablets, and smartphones accessing AI products via websites and apps. It does not include browser plugins, desktop software, mini-programs, Discord or other third-party apps, or locally run open-source code. Statistics cover AI products with more than 10,000 monthly visits; within that filter we focus on global Top 30/50/100, China Top 30/50/100, and China-outbound Top 30/50/100 products — aiming at high-activity products with broad user bases.

Use. Given collection complexity and market change, figures may contain error or omission. Treat them as research reference, not definitive investment advice. When citing data, credit 【Data source: Unique Research】; when citing charts, 【Data source: Unique Research; chart: Unique Research】.

3.2 Definitions

Geography. Overseas AI products — founded by non-Chinese entrepreneurs/teams, mainly for global markets (including home market). Domestic AI products — founded by Chinese nationals/teams, mainly for China. Outbound AI products — founded by Chinese entrepreneurs/teams but primarily targeting overseas (non-China) markets.

Function. AI-native apps — designed from day one around AI; core value, workflow, or UX depend on AI. AI-feature apps — existing products that add AI to enhance or create functions. AI ecosystem apps — platforms that support, connect, or foster exchange among AI researchers, developers, providers, and end users.

3.3 Metrics

WEB: Visits (sessions; 30+ min idle or new day = new visit); Unique Visitors (unique IPs in the period); Visit Duration (average time in a session).

APP: Downloads; Sessions (opens; multiple opens within 5 seconds count as one); Active Users (unique users with ≥1 activity in the period); Duration Time (total time spent in the app).

3.4 About Unique Research

Unique Research is the professional new-business innovation and development research center under Unique Capital. It focuses on domestic and outbound enterprise-service ecosystems — new marketing, new retail, new experience — and on applying data, AI, and automation across consumer retail, local services, healthcare, and more. The team comes from research consultancies, private funds, and tech media.

3.5 Disclaimer

This report is independent original analysis by Unique Research as a third party. It does not represent any company’s position and does not constitute investment advice. Investment decisions based on it are unrelated to Unique Research, its staff, or affiliates. Where legally permitted, Unique Research or affiliates may hold equity in mentioned companies or provide/seek financing or advisory services; staff may serve as directors of mentioned companies.

— END —
